0022600179.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (3-4, on a three-game winning streak) host the Utah Jazz (1-6, on a five-game losing streak) in their eighth game of the season, with the Pelicans 11th in the West and the Jazz 14th. Utah took the only meeting so far in 2026-27, a 120-119 win in Salt Lake City on October 23, after New Orleans swept the 2025-26 series 3-0. New Orleans will be without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise).
